req.title: Content-Type is JSON
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /players endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-026 mandates that every /players/* endpoint returning a body must set Content-Type: application/json. We must verify this for all body-returning endpoints (GET /players/, GET /players/{id}, GET /players/squadnumber/{n}, POST /players/) and confirm that no-body endpoints (PUT 204, DELETE 204) are excluded from the requirement. Tests cover: positive EP for each body-returning endpoint, negative path for 404 error responses (which still return a JSON body), and boundary cases around the exact Content-Type string value. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact header string 'application/json' rather than a substring, and by checking status codes exactly.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains 26 pre-loaded player rows
actions: Send GET /players/
Inspect response status code and Content-Type header
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got: {ct}'
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 26

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_plain
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Player with squad_number=1 exists in the database
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/1
Assert Content-Type is exactly 'application/json' (with optional charset suffix)
Assert Content-Type is NOT 'text/html' and NOT 'text/plain'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_plain():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/1')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got: {ct}'
    assert not ct.startswith('text/html'), f'Content-Type must not be text/html, got: {ct}'
    assert not ct.startswith('text/plain'), f'Content-Type must not be text/plain, got: {ct}'
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Armani'

tests.name: test_get_all_players_content_type_boundary_first_and_last_squad
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Players with squad_number=1 and squad_number=26 exist (boundary rows)
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/1 (lowest squad number in dataset)
Send GET /players/squadnumber/26 (highest squad number in dataset)
Assert Content-Type is application/json for both
expected: HTTP 200 for squad 1 with application/json Content-Type
HTTP 200 for squad 26 with application/json Content-Type
Both responses parse as valid JSON with correct squadNumber

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_content_type_boundary_first_and_last_squad():

    assert r1.status_code == 200
    ct1 = r1.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct1.startswith('application/json'), f'squad 1 CT: {ct1}'
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert body1['squadNumber'] == 1

    r26 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/26')

tests.name: test_get_all_players_response_is_parseable_json_list
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains exactly 26 pre-loaded player rows
actions: Send GET /players/
Assert Content-Type is application/json
Assert response body is a JSON array of exactly 26 items
expected: Response body is a list of 26 player objects

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_response_is_parseable_json_list():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got: {ct}'

    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26
    squad_numbers = [p['squadNumber'] for p in body]
